'''2014 Alderaan Regionals Nathan DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Nathan]] at [[2014 Alderaan Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe]]
* '''Username:''' SolaGratia
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
